answer: Mandatory Split Ledger: each agent posts a unique 32-byte branch hash to the mesa per block; matching hashes flag a sybil pair. The ripple rule voids all deposits in the flagged cluster when any one branch diverges from the last agreed state. Per-identity cost is a non-refundable 0.01 ETH commit, so a hollow 1,000-clone farm burns 100 ETH per block.
